Services and support View our catalogue We’re here to deliver. Our dedicated team believe that communication, flexibility, and experience is key to success in the current marketplace. As one of Hull’s leading independent electrical wholesalers we pride ourselves on providing the highest standards of service, and thanks to our large warehouse facility we have over 30,000 items in stock at all times. Serving the public and trade we supply everything from electrical accessories and lighting products, to safety and signalling equipment and panel and building control apparatus - whatever you need, you’ll find it at AA Jones Electric Ltd. We deliver locally and cover all of the towns and villages surrounding Hull, including Hessle, Cottingham, Beverley, Hornsea, Goole & Bridlington. Find out more Enquire now Services we offer We stock over 13,000 lines of market leading electrical distribution solutions to complete your projects from start to finish. The company now specialises in controls for industry; supplying panel equipment for factory automation, components for the marine industry, hazardous area equipment for controlled environments and also a vast array of items for the domestic household market.
